blind.description: A stylized wooden weapon rack designed for martial training. It features two sturdy vertical timber posts anchored by metal-bracketed feet, supporting a row of six wooden practice swords (wasters) with rounded spherical pommels and crossguards. Mounted on the outer side of each post is a small circular wooden buckler with a central metal boss. The reverse side features a solid planked wooden backboard with securing pegs. All surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted wood grain and polished steel hardware, sitting flat on the ground without an extra base plinth.
blind.from_above: It appears as a narrow rectangular wooden frame spanning horizontally, punctuated at each end by square post tops and small circular shield edges, with a straight row of six rounded spherical sword pommels running down the middle.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-high to the figure, roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall (about half the figure's height), and approximately 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
